plugin.name: Antigravity CLI
plugin.description: Google's Antigravity CLI as a coding agent, with your own Google account.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Antigravity CLI to Settings → Agents, beside Claude Code and Codex. Install it, sign in with `agy acp --login`, then turn it on in Settings → Agents; OhMyGame reads its models from the agent. Use it with a Google account; Gemini Code Assist plans can also use Gemini CLI.
